name: Ateneo Circle of Computer Enthusiasts for Study and Success (ACCESS)
description: ACCESS is the official academic club and the academic arm of the Computer Studies Cluster at Ateneo de Davao University. ACCESS creates a space where technology and passion come together. The official organization for all Computer Studies students, fostering tech literacy and innovation.

name: Samahan ng Mga Mag-Aaral ng Pamantasang Ateneo de Davao
description: The Samahan ng Mga Mag-Aaral ng Pamantasang Ateneo de Davao, or SAMAHAN, is the lone autonomous Student Government of the College unit of Ateneo de Davao University. SAMAHAN at the very top of the student organization food chain.

name: SAMAHAN Creative Team (SCT)
description: We are the pixel workers behind SAMAHAN. The official creative solutions committee of the SAMAHAN Central Board.

name: Young Entrepreneurs Society (YES)
description: The official academic organization for the university's Entrepreneurship Department. It serves as a platform to develop student entrepreneurs.

name: Ateneo Filipino-Chinese Community (AFCC)
description: AFCC is an organization composed of both Filipino and Chinese Ateneans enrolled in the ADDU.It serves as a space for students to foster cultural appreciation, dialogue, and community among individuals of various backgrounds.

name: Ateneo Japanese and Kendo Community (AJKC)
description: Experience Japan with us! The Ateneo Japanese and Kendo Community (AJKC) promotes appreciation of Japanese culture through educational, cultural, and social activities..

name: Interdisciplinary Studies Association (1SA)
description: Unity and Excellence in Diversity Interdisciplinary Minds, Fathomless Possibilities! ISA is the home organization for students interested in global affairs, diplomacy, international relations, and cross-cultural understanding.

name: SALAM: The Ateneo Muslim Society
description: The Ateneo Muslim Society is the home organization for Muslim students in Ateneo de Davao University, fostering faith, community, and personal growth..

name: Samahan ng mga Mag-aaral ng Sining at Komunikasyon (SINIKOM)
description: SINIKOM is an organization tailored for Communication Majors in Ateneo de Davao University.

name: Tanglaw - The Ateneo Folk Dance Society
description: The AdDU Folk Dance Society is a cultural organization dedicated to preserving and promoting Philippine folk dances and traditions. Members develop their performance skills through regular training, cultural presentations, and university events.

name: Ateneo Catechetical Instructions League (ACIL)
description: The longest-running religious student organization of the Ateneo since 1905. The Ateneo Catechetical Instruction League is a faith-based organization dedicated to forming student catechists and servant leaders.

name: Campus Liturgical Ministries (CLM)
description: The Campus Liturgical Ministries (CLM) is one of the religious club under the Ateneo Religious Organizations (ARO).The Campus Liturgical Ministry is a faith-based organization dedicated to serving the university through liturgical and worship ministries.

name: Christ's Youth in Action (CYA)
description: We are the Ateneo de Davao unit of Christ’s Youth in Action (CYA)— a movement of young people from across Asia that evangelize & train future leaders for the Church and society.

name: Subdominant 7
description: The Ateneo de Davao University Chapel Choir. SubDominant7 is the official college chapel choir of Ateneo de Davao University, dedicated to serving the university through music and liturgical ministry.

name: Ateneo Green-Agripreneurs for Renewable and Eco-friendly Enterprises Society (AGREES)
description: AGREES is a student organization that promotes sustainable agriculture, renewable energy, and environmentally responsible innovation.

name: Ateneo Marketing Club (AMC)
description: AMARC is the official organization for Marketing students at Ateneo de Davao University. It helps members develop their marketing, creativity, and leadership skills through seminars, competitions, and industry-related projects.

name: Ateneo Society of Management Students (ASMS)
description: ASMS is the official organization for Management students at Ateneo de Davao University. It helps members strengthen their leadership, management, and professional skills through seminars, activities, and collaborative projects.

name: Junior Finance Executives (JFINEX)
description: The Junior Finance Executives is the official student organization of the Ateneo de Davao University Bachelor of Science in Finance Program.

name: Junior People Management Association of the Philippines (JPMAP)
description: JPMA is the official organization for Human Resource Management students at Ateneo de Davao University. JPMA brings together students interested in human resource management and organizational development.

name: Junior Philippine Association of Management Accountants (JPAMA)
description: JPAMA is the official organization for Management Accounting students at Ateneo de Davao University. It provides opportunities to explore the field through case competitions, academic events, industry talks, and professional networking.

name: Junior Philippine Institute of Accountants - AdDU Local Chapter (JPIA)
description: JPIA is the official organization for Accountancy students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes academic competitions, seminars, networking events, and activities that enrich students' understanding of the accounting profession.

name: Junior Philippine Society for Public Management - AdDU Chapter (JPSPM)
description: JPSPM is the official organization for Public Management students at Ateneo de Davao University. It explores topics in public service, governance, and policymaking through seminars, forums, community initiatives, and academic activities.

name: Ateneo Society of Industrial Engineering Majors (ASIEM)
description: The Ateneo Society of Industrial Engineering Majors (ASIEM) is the Academic oganization of all Industrial Engineering students.It organizes academic events, competitions, industry talks, and collaborative activities that highlight the principles and applications of industrial engineering.

name: United Architects of the Philippines Student Auxiliary - UAPSA Doric
description: UAPSA DORIC is the official organization for Architecture students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes design competitions, workshops, exhibits, and industry events that showcase creativity and the practice of architecture.

name: Federation of United Students of Electrical Engineering (FUSEE)
description: FUSEE is the official organization for Electrical Engineering students at Ateneo de Davao University. It brings students together through technical seminars, engineering competitions, academic activities, and outreach programs related to the field.

name: Global Engineering Ateneo Robotics Society (GEARS)
description: Global Engineering – Ateneo Robotics Society (GEARS), the official academic organization and main page representing the AdDU-SEA Robotics Engineering Department.

name: Junior Philippine Institute of Chemical Engineers (JPICHE)
description: Junior Philippine Institute of Chemical Engineers is the academic Club of the Chemical Engineering Department of the Ateneo de Davao University

name: Junior Philippine Institute of Civil Engineers (JPICE)
description: JPICE is the official organization for Civil Engineering students at Ateneo de Davao University. It hosts seminars, competitions, site visits, and activities that introduce members to the civil engineering profession.

name: Liga ng mga Inhinyerong Panghimpapawid at Pangkalawakan ng Ateneo de Davao (LIPPAD)
description: The official academic organization of the Aerospace Engineering Department. It organizes talks, workshops, and academic activities that explore aviation, space technology, and aerospace engineering.

name: Mekanikal na Asosasyon ng Kabataang Inhinyerong Atenista (MAKINA)
description: MAKINA is the official organization for Mechanical Engineering students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes technical talks, competitions, workshops, and activities that showcase the applications of mechanical engineering.

name: Prominent Computer Engineering Students' Organization (PROCESSOR)
description: PROCESSOR is the official organization for Computer Engineering students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes technical workshops, competitions, and projects that give members opportunities to apply and expand their engineering knowledge.

name: Society of Electronics Engineering Students (SELECOMES)
description: SELECOMES is the official organization for Electronics Engineering students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes technical seminars, competitions, and hands-on activities that expose members to the latest developments in electronics and communication technologies.

name: Ateneo de Davao Association of Chemistry Students (ADDACS)
description: The Ateneo de Davao Association of Chemistry Students is the official organization for Chemistry students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes academic activities, laboratory-related events, and outreach programs that promote the study and application of chemistry.

name: Ateneo de Davao Mathematics Society (ADDAMS)
description: ADDAMS is the official organization for Mathematics students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes problem-solving competitions, seminars, and academic activities that promote mathematics and analytical thinking.

name: Environmental Science Community (ENVICO)
description: The ADDU Environmental Science Community (EnviCo) is the academic organization of the BS Environmental Science program in Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes environmental campaigns, field activities, and community initiatives that promote sustainability and environmental awareness.

name: Philippine Nursing Students' Association (PNSA)
description: The Sole Academic Organization of Ateneo de Davao University - School of Nursing. It organizes academic, service, and student activities that support the nursing community and promote excellence in healthcare.

name: The Ateneo Biological Society (TABS)
description: The Ateneo Biological Society is the official organization for Biology students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes academic events, outreach programs, and environmental activities that promote the study and appreciation of the biological sciences.

name: Ateneo International Studies Students Organization (AISSO)
description: AISSO brings together international students at Ateneo de Davao University and promotes cultural exchange within the campus community.

name: Ateneo Islamic Studies Students Association (AISSA)
description: AISSA is the official organization for Islamic Studies students at Ateneo de Davao University. It promotes a deeper understanding of Islamic teachings, culture, and values through educational, cultural, and community-centered activities.

name: Ateneo Economics Society (ECOSOC)
description: The Ateneo Economics Society is the official organization for Economics students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes discussions, seminars, and academic activities that explore economic issues, public policy, and current trends.

name: Future Educators of Ateneo (FEAT)
description: The Future Educators of Ateneo (FEAT) is the official academic club of Ateneo de Davao University's School of Education.

name: Junior Social Worker's Association of the Philippines (JSWAP)
description: JSWAP is the official organization for Social Work students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes community outreach, advocacy initiatives, and academic activities that promote social justice, service, and professional social work practice

name: Mindanawon Anthropological Society of the Ateneo (MASA)
description: MASA is the official organization for Anthropology students at Ateneo de Davao University. It promotes a deeper understanding of Mindanao’s diverse cultures through discussions, field activities, research, and community engagement.

name: Samahang Mag-aaral ng Sikolohiyang Filipino (SAMASIKOFIL)
description: The Official Academic Organization of Ateneo de Davao University - Department of Psychology. It organizes academic events, mental health initiatives, and community activities that promote psychology and psychological well-being.

name: Samahan ng mga Mag-aaral ng Agham Pampulitika ng Ateneo (SAMAPULA)
description: SAMAPULAA is the official organization for Political Science students at Ateneo de Davao University. It organizes forums, discussions, and academic activities that encourage critical engagement with politics, governance, and contemporary social issues.

name: Bahaghari
description: The Progressive Socio-Political Organization of Ateneo, defined by our dictum of Meliora - Better. It is an advocacy organization that promotes gender equality, diversity, and LGBTQIA+ inclusion within the Ateneo community.

name: CATeneo
description: CATeneo is an animal welfare organization that promotes compassion, responsible pet ownership, and the protection of animals. It organizes awareness campaigns, volunteer activities, and initiatives that support the well-being of stray and rescued animals.

name: College Red Cross Youth (CRCY)
description: CRCY is a humanitarian organization that promotes volunteerism, first aid, disaster preparedness, and community service among Ateneans. It organizes blood donation drives, emergency response training, outreach programs, and other initiatives guided by the principles of the Philippine Red Cross.

moderator.name: Roy Cresencio R. Linao Jr., MN RN

name: POWER AdDU (Protection of Women's Equality and Rights)
description: The pioneering women-centered organization of Ateneo de Davao University, advocating for women's equality and rights. Only women are allowed to join here. #FearlessandForward

name: Ateneo Cavalry Esports Society (ACES)
description: ACES is Ateneo de Davao University's official esports organization, bringing together students who share a passion for competitive gaming and the local gaming community. It organizes tournaments, community events, and gaming activities that promote teamwork, sportsmanship, and esports culture on campus.

name: Ateneo Dance Crew (ADC)
description: ADC is the official dance organization of Ateneo de Davao University, showcasing various dance styles through performances and competitions. It participates in university events and national dance competitions while promoting creativity, discipline, and the performing arts.

name: Ateneo de Davao University Chorale (ADDUC)
description: AdDUC is the university's official chorale group, showcasing choral music through performances, competitions, and university events. It promotes musical excellence and cultural expression through vocal training and collaborative performances.

name: Ateneo Debate Varsity (ADV)
description: The Ateneo Debate Varsity (ADV) is the official debate and public speaking organization of the Ateneo de Davao University. It trains students in debate, argumentation, and public discourse through competitions, workshops, and speaking activities.

name: Ateneo Repertory Company (ARC)
description: A versatile performing arts company showcasing home-grown talents in voice, theater, music creation, and multimedia at Ateneo de Davao University.

name: Ateneo Sidlak Performing Arts Collective (ASPAC)
description: The leading performing arts collective of the Ateneo de Davao University, dedicated to bridging and promoting cultures of Mindanao.

name: Ateneo Student Security Force (ASSF)
description: ASSF is a student organization that supports campus safety and security initiatives at Ateneo de Davao University. It trains members in emergency response, first aid, and disaster preparedness while assisting in maintaining a safe university environment.

name: Council of Organizations of the Ateneo - Davao (COA-D)
description: The Council of Organizations of the Ateneo - Davao is the umbrella council of all recognized clubs and organizations of the Ateneo de Davao University. It brings together and supports accredited organizations within the university.

name: AdDU COMELEC
description: The constitutional electoral and independent body of Ateneo de Davao University. AdDU COMELEC is the independent electoral body responsible for organizing and overseeing student elections within the university.

name: KALASAG
description: Kalasag - Ang Taunang Aklat ng Ateneo de Davao University. The Facebook page of this organization was not active since 2019.

name: Atenews
description: The Official Student Publication of Ateneo de Davao University, covering campus news, social issues, features, and student perspectives.

name: Ateneo Lumad Students Organization (ALSO)
description: Ang nag inusarang hulagway sa paglambo ug pagpadayon sa kultura sa mga Lumad sa Ateneo.

name: Ateneo Film Circle (AFC)
description: Ateneo Film Circle (AFC) is the premier student film organization based at the Ateneo de Davao University.

name: Ateneo Photographers' Society (APS)
description: APS is the official photography organization of Ateneo de Davao University, bringing together students with a passion for photography and visual storytelling.

name: Ateneo Art Company (ArtCo)
description: ArtCo is a visual arts organization of Ateneo de Davao University, providing a space for students to explore and showcase their creativity.

name: Kapisanan ng Pag-aaral Pangkaunlaran at Sosyolohiya (KAPPS)
description: Isang organisasyong naghahangad patungo sa mas maliwanag na kinabukasan—para sa Mindanao at higit pa!
